items.question: What petroleum products, and roughly how much of each, were aboard the MPC 644 and MPC 907 when the two barges drifted loose on the Ohio River near Evansville?
items.expected_answer: The MPC 644 held about 23,000 barrels of no. 2 ultra low sulfur (MV15) diesel fuel, and the MPC 907 held about 27,328 barrels of no. 84 conventional-blend-grade gasoline.

evidence.quote: The MPC 644 was carrying about 23,000 barrels of no. 2 ultra low sulfur (MV15) diesel fuel. The MPC 907 was carrying about 27,328 barrels of no. 84 conventional-blend-grade gasoline.

items.notes: Tests retrieval of the cargo carried by each barge, phrased in lay terms.

items.question: Where and at about what time were the barges MPC 907 and MPC 644 recovered by EMS tugs after breaking free from the MPC terminal dock?
items.expected_answer: EMS tugs recovered the barges near mile 802 about 0700 and returned them to the MPC facility dock.

evidence.quote: The barges were recovered by EMS tugs near mile 802 about 0700 and returned to the MPC facility dock.

items.notes: Tests a narrative fact about the barge recovery using the report's own terms.
